dataset.name: DB3V
dataset.purpose: Regional held-out evaluation. Recordings in this dataset directory are isolated from any DB3V support used for fitting and are not used for training, early stopping, or model selection.
dataset.feature_protocol: Precomputed non-overlapping one-second feature slices. The feature shape and label map are validated against each model; MFCC, LogMel, and PCEN inputs are produced by the corresponding dataset_processing pipeline.

source_recording_protocol: Eight-second chunks are averaged within their original source recording before classification; each independent source receives one vote in the primary DB3V metric.
